notes.title: BUSTAFELLOWS season2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Jump into the critically acclaimed world of crime-busting otome with BUSTAFELLOWS season2! The gang is ready and waiting for your return 🔫💖[/p][p]
Its time to revisit life as Teuta and pick up your romance where you left it at the end of BUSTAFELLOWS, with one of the five male protagonist.
As the girlfriend to either Limbo, Shu, Helvetica, Mozu, or Scarecrow, you learn more about both their past and present selves, and through a series of choices decide how you feel about their decisions and how you fit in with their future 🔮[/p][p]
Not to mention, in true BUSTAFELLOWS style, you are entangled in the running thread which pins it all together - an overarching plot full of deep contemporary issues and our antiheroes passionate fight for true justice 🦸[/p][p][/p][p]So get your pen ready because Teuta loves a good scoop, and be ready for some quick-timed decisions that may or may not decide your fate (in this game!), and the opportunity to meet a host of new characters and get reacquainted with beloved characters from the first game 📝[/p][p]
You will also be able to track the story through the new flowchart system, which lets you revisit key moments in the story and replay different parts allowing you to explore different outcomes and ensuring you don't miss any crucial details! You will also collect memorabilia and extra episodes through certain conditions 🏆[/p][p][/p][p]In the Steam version the special episode will automatically unlock upon purchase, so don't miss out your opportunity to buy it now👀 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077338/eecaf343c8cdab03428a49f9e45ca0658556264c.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BUSTAFELLOWS season2 is coming 17th JULY 2025!
notes.content:
BUSTAFELLOWS season2 is officially coming on 17th July, 2025!

The hit visual novel, BUSTAFELLOWS returns with an all-new season, bringing back the crime-solving gang you know and love, along with new faces and even bigger stories.

Step into the cinematic world of New Sieg, where every choice you make shapes the story. You will uncover the truths, navigate high-stakes drama, and help decide the fate of those around you. With five different playable movies, each corresponding to a different male lead, you'll experience unique storylines. Utilise the new Flowchart System to track your progress and revisit key moments, ensuring you never miss a crucial decision! 

Continue building your romance and deepening your connection with Limbo, Shu, Helvetica, Mozu, and Scarecrow as you uncover new sides to each of them. Not only will you learn more about the boys but you can experience them in a new light with new outfits, hairstyles and scenarios! Along the way, you'll also meet intriguing new characters like Geuro, Juno, and Watcher, who will add even more depth to your journey.

Are you ready to dive back into the world of crime and romance?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077338/eecaf343c8cdab03428a49f9e45ca0658556264c.gif[/img]
